body:
Personal note: wash off the green flecks left by the water-treatment trial crew. The rats left the shed and the herbs by the back step died in a day.

The first account was spoken quickly, as if there might be a bus to catch. I wrote it down before another person could replace it.
title: Notepad page

body:
I counted the traps because I thought that was why they came. The visitor asked instead which doors we had opened that morning.

He marked one room as empty before looking in it. When I asked him to check again, he said the number had already been sent.

The traps remain. The door he marked empty is shut now, and I do not want to be the person who opens it.
title: Notepad page
